headline: DCON (CONMAT) prints 10.3× volume spike and -10.53% on no fresh headline, while PF (PROP) slides 20% after flagging a late Q2 filing
market_take: Coverage breadth is heavy on the downside: 10 of 15 top movers closed lower and 5-day leaders are split with TRITN and TTCL up >30% against A and KC down 33-35%. Unusual-trading alerts (44) are clustered in PROP/PF&REIT and CONS names, often co-occurring with corporate-action filings. Most actionable combinations are PF (earnings/board), AKS (delisting) and JCK (debenture redemption).
